name: write_file
description: Write text contents to a file inside the workspace, creating parent directories as needed. Overwrites an existing file. Returns the workspace-relative path and the number of bytes written.

humanDescription.detailed: Writes text contents to a file, creating parent directories if needed.
humanDescription.playful: Put your mark on the file.

path.description: Workspace-relative path of the file to write.

content.description: Full text contents to write to the file.
